17f133b9371966f0.title: Le Patin Libre: Melt
17f133b9371966f0.desc: In a scorching post-apocalyptic world where ice, music, and civilization no longer exist, a duet of skaters survives. Eerily observed by a gas-guzzling musician, they live on with what remains: ingenuity, humor, and love. Faced with the perils of a chaotic future, their friendship is matched only by their astonishing athleticism as they glide, jump, and dance their way to dizzying heights.On theater stages for the first time, Le Patin Libre seizes the opportunity to explore an intimacy and weirdness impossible in traditional ice rinks. Performing on a forgotten 1990s prototype of roller skates, they brilliantly transpose the athletic virtuosity of figure skating into a theatrical world that blends contemporary dance, street performance, acrobatics, pirouettes, and intelligent stage humor.

1740325260cb4561.title: Nest Healing Art Studio
1740325260cb4561.desc: HEALING ART STUDIO - FOR TEENS & ADULTS First Wednesday or Sunday of the Month, 1-2p ​​ NEST is a free, one-hour program dedicated to mindful, judgment-free art making. Guided by licensed art therapist Emily Skelton, each session begins with a calming meditation, followed by a demonstration of that day’s unique art project. Mindfulness in both meditation and art helps us regulate emotions, reduce stress, and focus our attention. Each week’s project is a surprise, revealed at the start of class to invite openness and curiosity. This gentle uncertainty is part of the healing process, helping us meet ourselves where we are, embrace vulnerability, and discover growth through creativity. No art experience is needed. You’ll be supported every step of the way in a safe, welcoming space for exploration and self-expression. Developed under the direction of Emily Skelton, LMFT, ATR-BC (to learn more about Emily, please go to her website). Notes This is a free, drop in program intended for teens and adults only. Please do not bring small children. Preregister to reserve your space and please let us know if you will not be able to attend. No shows will be removed from future registrations.

170c0507f53a8a55.title: Damian's Not So Haunted House
170c0507f53a8a55.desc: Come for a 0% scary and 100% Halloween fun for all ages, specifically catered to the very youngest trick-or-treaters. The experience is like Disneyland's Haunted Mansion attraction turned into a Mickey Mouse Clubhouse episode. The Not-So-Haunted house is open to the public October 16-17, 22-24, and Oct 27 - Oct 31 from 5-8 PM. The event is put on by a mother fighting for her son's life. 7-year-old Damian is currently suffering from the rare and fatal genetic disease called ASMD (also known as Niemann-Pick Disease Type A or baby Alzheimer's). You can visit SaveDamian.com to read Damian's full story. Damian's mom is transforming her garage into Damian’s Not-So-Haunted house, complete with a photo spot opportunity, an engaging walkthrough, and Disneyland decor straight from Disney’s exclusive vault. You can read all about what to expect here. You can also support by buying shirts promoting the event here - they glow in the dark! All funds raised at the Not-So-Haunted House go to the Wylder Nation Foundation (WNF), which is the only organization laser-focused on developing the treatment needed to save Damian's life. This year’s goal is to raise $15,000, and we can accomplish it with…
